core_obligations: Construct the presheaf (proof lines 4946-4952): the author considers the presheaf assigning to an etale U over S the set of morphisms from U to the final object along which the two sections agree, which is a subpresheaf of the final presheaf.

Sheafify (proof lines 4952-4957): its sheafification is the representable sheaf of an open subscheme W, and the universal property of sheafification shows that a morphism T -> S factors through W exactly when the two sections agree after restriction, which is the stated characterisation.
proof_roadmap: Form the subpresheaf of the final presheaf consisting of the loci where the sections agree.
Sheafify it and identify the result with the sheaf represented by an open W.
Read off the characterising property of W.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the largest open subscheme W of S on which two sections of a sheaf of sets agree, characterised by the factoring property of the statement (statement lines 4937-4944). The proof forms the subpresheaf of the final presheaf consisting of the loci where the two sections agree (proof lines 4946-4952), sheafifies it and identifies the result as the representable sheaf of an open subscheme, whose universal property gives exactly the stated characterisation (proof lines 4952-4957). The non-formal content is the identification of the sheafified presheaf with a representable one. The claim is H2: one construction plus one universal-property argument.
